line.en: the old flea market from cascorro down ribera de curtidores, 09:00 to 15:00. go before ten, when it gets crowded; metro la latina.
line.de: der alte flohmarkt von der plaza cascorro die ribera de curtidores hinunter, 9 bis 15 uhr. vor zehn hin, dann wird es voll; u-bahn la latina.
line.tr: cascorro'dan ribera de curtidores boyunca inen eski bit pazarı, 09:00 – 15:00. on olmadan git, sonra kalabalıklaşır; metro la latina.

sparks.why: El Rastro runs every Sunday and holiday 09:00 to 15:00 from Plaza de Cascorro down Ribera de Curtidores, per mercadillos.org and visitmadrid.es; no closure found for Sun 8 Nov.
